title: Splunk Hunt
description: Executes OpenCTI hunts on Splunk Enterprise or Splunk Cloud. OpenCTI dispatches one hunt run per hunt and time window; the connector translates the canonical Sigma rule of the hunt into SPL with pySigma (Windows, Sysmon acceleration or CIM data model pipelines) or runs the native SPL query written for Splunk, executes it as a Splunk search job over the run window within the run timeout and result limits, and reports the run to OpenCTI. When the hunt matches, the techniques and indicators of the hunt are sighted on the Splunk Security Platform and the IOC observables found in the results are sent as observed-data. Raw events never leave Splunk: OpenCTI only receives counts and a hashed, truncated evidence sample.
short_description: Runs OpenCTI hunts (Sigma translated to SPL, or native SPL) as Splunk search jobs and reports sightings, observed IOCs and redacted evidence.
